note: Camera gates are fly-car's fit on this Uno Q (color_thresholds.json, 2026-11-15), not a wide indoor guess. Hue is degrees; OpenCV stores half of that. Red is (hue <= hue_low) or (hue >= hue_wrap). hue_low -1 turns the low side off, so only hue >= 322 counts: the paper sits near 340, and hue 0 was false red (orange, wood, skin). Blue is the closed interval 180-220. Saturation and value are 0-255 floors. A connected blob smaller than 0.2% of the frame is dropped in code (REGION_MIN_FRACTION). fraction_floor is this app's extra deadband: a smaller eye fill is logged and is not passed to the brain. If a red panel near hue 0 is missed, raise hue_low (for example to 20). If a blue panel near 240 is missed, raise hue_high. Raise saturation if a wall still counts.
